faq.whatBody: The Forever Jukebox is an open-source modernization of Paul Lamere’s <infinite>Infinite Jukebox</infinite> and <canon>Autocanonizer</canon> — rebuilt from the ground up by <author>Creighton Linza</author>. It generates a forever-evolving version of any song.
faq.playModesBody: It has three play modes: Jukebox keeps a song going forever by jumping between beats that sound alike, Autocanonizer plays a song against itself as a canon, and Wub Machine turns it into a dubstep remix (based on Peter Sobot's <wub>Wub Machine</wub>).
faq.howBody: The Forever Jukebox listens to a song and maps out its beats. As the song plays, it can jump from one beat to another that sounds similar, so the music keeps going in a new direction instead of ending. The visualization draws every possible jump as a line across the track. In the Classic view, each beat is a tile around the circle that grows as it replays, so you can see which parts of the song have played most. A tile's color reflects how that beat sounds. Hover over a beat to see where it can jump, and click it to go there.
faq.sourceBody: The full source code is available in the <repo>forever-jukebox</repo> repository.
faq.tuneTitle: How can I tune the Jukebox?
faq.tuneOpen: Click the Tune button to open the tuning panel.
faq.tuneThreshold: The threshold sets how alike two beats must sound to connect: lower means smoother jumps, higher means more of them.
faq.tuneProbability: Adjust branch probability min/max and ramp speed to shape how often jumps happen.
faq.tuneTypes: Set a minimum jump distance to filter branches by beat distance across the track, and use the checkboxes for other branch types.
faq.tuneDelete: Click a branch in the visualization, then press Delete to remove it.
faq.modesTitle: What are the extra audio modes?
faq.modesTempo: Nightcore, Daycore & Vaporwave: sped up, slowed and deepened, or further slowed and muffled.
faq.modesMetronome: Metronome: hi/lo click track aligned to the song's beats and bars.
faq.modesRemix: More Cowbell & Swing: beat-aware remix toys inspired by Echo Nest Remix.
faq.modesInstrumental: Instrumental: removes the vocals with an on-device separation model (desktop browsers only).
faq.storageBody: Analysis is stored locally in your browser. You can clear individual track analysis on the Home screen, or all cached analysis from Settings.

manifest.description: Offline-first Forever Jukebox for local audio.
